name: TWITTER 骓特 Gravel V3 2024 RS 2×12
why_interesting: This discontinued 2024 mechanical 2×12 build used the older press-fit carbon V3 frame. The seller material lists multiple wheel selections and claims 9.5 kg for one configuration, but the photographed bike does not establish which wheel package is fitted. It is no longer sold new and was superseded by the 2025 Gravel V3.
availability_note: This 2024 version is no longer sold new. It was superseded by the 2025 Gravel V3; only used examples or independently verified remaining stock may surface.
missing: The original historical retail price tied specifically to this exact RS 2x12 carbon-wheel/photo-led configuration
An original order-detail SKU or equivalent evidence tying the listing photographs to an exact wheel selection
Resolution of the listing's 50-versus-51 size-grid and BB86-versus-BB92 wording conflicts
Readable component markings confirming the exact production-batch shifters, derailleurs, crank, cassette, and brakes
Dependable provenance for any used example or claimed remaining stock
The 9.5 kg seller claim is not mapped to the retained carbon-wheel configuration; the 9.9 kg claim applies to an alloy-wheel selection.
catalog_distinct_reason: The seller material mixes multiple 2024 RS 2×12 wheel and color selections. This research profile keeps the unresolved photographed configuration separate from the published alloy-wheel variant rather than treating one pictured wheel package as standard.

facts.listing_identity: Taobao item GRAVEL-V3顺泰; listed launch Summer 2024; the wheel-and-color selection matrix includes six colors and separate alloy- and carbon-wheel options
facts.frame: Seller-listed high-modulus carbon frame and carbon fork with fully internal routing
facts.bottom_bracket: Press-fit; the Taobao component table is transcribed as BB92×41×24, while a second supplied listing summary calls the older frame BB86
facts.axles: 12×100 mm front and 12×142 mm rear thru-axles
facts.drivetrain: Seller-listed RS/Sensah mechanical 2×12; HRC/HRD6900-family controls and RD8500-family rear derailleur are not independently confirmed from readable markings
facts.front_derailleur: One listing table says Microshift; another reused product graphic says RS, so the production-batch part remains conflicted
facts.crankset: SENICX PR6 hollow-alloy 50/34T in the supplied listing transcription
facts.cassette_and_chain: Sunshine 12-speed 11–32T cassette and SUMC 12-speed chain in the supplied listing transcription
facts.brakes: Seller-listed full-hydraulic flat-mount Sensah/RS G100-family disc brakes
facts.rotors: Seller-listed 160 mm front and rear, center-lock
facts.wheels: The listing offers separate 38 mm alloy and approximately 50 mm carbon wheel selections. The photographs do not establish which package is shown, and neither selection is treated as standard for the model.
facts.tires: Innova 700×40C tan-wall listed as the original tire; later substitutions are possible
facts.cockpit: Carbon integrated handlebar/stem, nominally 420×90 mm, plus proprietary aero carbon seatpost
facts.sizes: Older materials and the described size-51 configuration indicate 45 / 48 / 51 / 54, but the visible Taobao selector transcription says 45 / 48 / 50 / 54
facts.geometry_size_51: Supplied listing transcription: 550 mm stack, 385 mm reach, 540 mm effective top tube, 130 mm head tube and 1,021 mm wheelbase; verify against the exact archived product graphic
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Exact-model 2024 instruction-manual mirror maximum for the matching press-fit generation
facts.complete_weight_basis: Historical seller claim of 9.5 kg for one 2024 configuration; the pictured wheel selection is unmapped, so this does not establish the carbon-wave build's weight. A separate 9.9 kg claim applies to the alloy-wheel selection. Size, pedals, accessories and weighing method are unknown.
facts.frame_stiffness_status: No exact historical-selection numeric or sufficiently specific independent stiffness result found after 50 registered source areas
facts.complete_weight_status: Seller-reported 9.5 kg for one unmapped 2024 configuration; not verified for this retained carbon-wave selection.

source_note: The historical seller material does not map a complete-bike weight to this exact 2024 RS carbon-wave configuration. A 9.5 kg claim is recorded for an unspecified build, while the exact alloy-wheel selection lists 9.9 kg. The CNY 3,991 alloy-wheel option and newer T47 prices are not transferred. Keep this build's weight unknown until the selected wheel package and weighing basis are documented.
price_status: No current mainland price or dependable stock evidence for the exact discontinued 2024 RS carbon-wheel selection. The historical CNY 3,991 amount applies only to its alloy-wheel selection; current 25yr USD prices are a different revision and market.
